verses.en: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared YAHUAH, and eschewed evil.
verses.am: ዖፅ በሚባል አገር ስሙ ኢዮብ የተባለ አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤ ያም ሰው ፍጹምና ቅን፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈራ፥ ከክፋትም የራቀ ነበረ።

verses.en: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.
verses.am: ሰባትም ወንዶች ሦስትም ሴቶች ልጆች ተወልደውለት ነበር።

verses.en: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.
verses.am: ሀብቱም ሰባት ሺህ በጎች፥ ሦስት ሺህም ግመሎች፥ አምስት መቶም ጥማድ በሬ፥ አምስት መቶም እንስት አህዮች ነበረ፥ እጅግ ብዙም ባሪያዎች ነበሩት፤ ያም ሰው በምሥራቅ ካሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ ይልቅ ታላቅ ነበረ።

verses.en: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.
verses.am: ወንዶች ልጆቹም ሄደው በየተራ በያንዳንዳቸው ቤት ግብዣ ያደርጉ ነበር፤ ሦስቱ እኅቶቻቸውም ከእነርሱ ጋር ይበሉና ይጠጡ ዘንድ እነርሱ ልከው ይጠሩአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed YAHUAH in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.
verses.am: የግብዣውም ቀኖች ባለፉ ጊዜ ኢዮብ። ምናልባት ልጆቼ በድለው፥ እግዚአብሔርንም በልባቸው ሰድበው ይሆናል ብሎ ይልክና ይቀድሳቸው ነበር፤ ኢዮብም ማልዶ ተነሣ፥ እንደ ቍጥራቸውም ሁሉ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት አቀረበ። እንዲሁ ኢዮብ ሁልጊዜ ያደርግ ነበር።

verses.en: Now there was a day when the sons of YAHUAH came to present themselves before YAHUAH, and Satan came also among them.
verses.am: ከዕለታት አንድ ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የአምላክ ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመቆም መጡ፥ ሰይጣንም ደግሞ በመካከላቸው መጣ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered YAHUAH, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። ከወዴት መጣህ? አለው። ሰይጣንም። ምድርን ሁሉ ዞርሁአት፥ በእርስዋም ተመላለስሁ ብሎ ለእግዚአብሔር መለሰ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth YAHUAH, and escheweth evil?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። በውኑ ባሪያዬን ኢዮብን ተመለከትኸውን? በምድር ላይ እንደ እርሱ ፍጹምና ቅን፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈራ፥ ከክፋትም የራቀ ሰው የለም አለው።

verses.en: Then Satan answered YAHUAH, and said, Doth Job fear YAHUAH for nought?
verses.am: ሰይጣንም ለእግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰለት። በውኑ ኢዮብ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ በከንቱ ነውን?

verses.en: Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.
verses.am: እርሱንና ቤቱን በዙሪያውም ያሉትን ሁሉ አላጠርህለትምን? የእጁን ሥራ ባርከህለታል፥ ከብቱም በምድር ላይ በዝቶአል።

verses.en: But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እጅህን ዘርግተህ ያለውን ሁሉ ዳብስ፤ በእውነት በፊትህ ይሰድብሃል።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። እነሆ ለእርሱ ያለው ሁሉ በእጅህ ነው፥ ነገር ግን በእርሱ ላይ እጅህን አትዘርጋ አለው። ሰይጣንም ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወጣ።

verses.en: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:
verses.am: አንድ ቀንም እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የኢዮብ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆች በታላቅ ወንድማቸው ቤት ይበሉና የወይን ጠጅ ይጠጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them:
verses.am: መልክተኛም ወደ ኢዮብ መጥቶ። በሬዎች እርሻ ያርሱ፥ በአጠገባቸውም አህዮች ይሰማሩ ነበር፤

verses.en: And the Sabeans fell upon them, and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.am: የሳባም ሰዎች አደጋ ጣሉ፥ ወሰዱአቸውም፥ ብላቴኖቹንም በሰይፍ ስለት ገደሉ፤ እኔም እነግርህ ዘንድ ብቻዬን አመለጥሁ አለው።

verses.en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of YAHUAH is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.am: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር ሌላ መጥቶ። የእግዚአብሔር እሳት ከሰማይ ወደቀች፥ በጎቹንም አቃጠለች፥ ጠባቂዎችንም በላች፤ እኔም እነግርህ ዘንድ ብቻዬን አመለጥሁ አለው።

verses.en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.am: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር ሌላ መጥቶ። ከለዳውያን በሦስት ረድፍ ተከፍለው በግመሎች ላይ አደጋ ጣሉ፥ ወሰዱአቸውም፥ ብላቴኖቹንም በሰይፍ ስለት ገደሉ፤ እኔም እነግርህ ዘንድ ብቻዬን አመለጥሁ አለው።

verses.en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:
verses.am: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር ሌላ መጥቶ። ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችህ በታላቅ ወንድማቸው ቤት ይበሉና የወይን ጠጅ ይጠጡ ነበር፤

verses.en: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ከምድረ በዳ መጥቶ የቤቱን አራቱን ማዕዘን መታው፥ በብላቴኖቹም ላይ ወደቀ፥ ሞቱም፤ እኔም እነግርህ ዘንድ ብቻዬን አመለጥሁ አለው።

verses.en: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,
verses.am: ኢዮብም ተነሣ መጐናጸፊያውንም ቀደደ፥ ራሱንም ተላጨ፥ በምድርም ላይ ተደፍቶ ሰገደ፤

verses.en: And said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: YAHUAH gave, and YAHUAH hath taken away; blessed be the name of YAHUAH.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። ራቁቴን ከእናቴ ማኅፀን ወጥቻለሁ፥ ራቁቴንም ወደዚያ እመለሳለሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሰጠ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ነሣ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ስም የተባረከ ይሁን።

verses.en: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged YAHUAH foolishly.
verses.am: በዚህ ሁሉ ኢዮብ አልበደለም፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ስንፍናን አልሰጠም።

verses.en: Again there was a day when the sons of YAHUAH came to present themselves before YAHUAH, and Satan came also among them to present himself before YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከዕለታት አንድ ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የአምላክ ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመቆም መጡ፥ ሰይጣን ደግሞ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመቆም በመካከላቸው መጣ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Satan, From whence comest thou? And Satan answered YAHUAH, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። ከወዴት መጣህ? አለው። ሰይጣንም። በምድር ላይ ዞርሁ፥ በእርስዋም ተመላለስሁ ብሎ ለእግዚአብሔር መለሰ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth YAHUAH, and escheweth evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። በውኑ ባሪያዬን ኢዮብን ተመለከትኸውን? በምድር ላይ እንደ እርሱ ፍጹምና ቅን፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈራ፥ ከክፋትም የራቀ ሰው የለም፤ በከንቱም አጠፋው ዘንድ አንተ በእርሱ ላይ ምንም ብታንቀሳቅሰኝ፥ እስከ አሁን ፍጹምነቱን ይዞአል።

verses.en: And Satan answered YAHUAH, and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.
verses.am: ሰይጣንም መልሶ እግዚአብሔርን። ቁርበት ስለ ቁርበት ነው፤ ሰው ያለውን ሁሉ ስለ ሕይወቱ ይሰጣል።

verses.en: But put forth thine hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee to thy face.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አሁን እጅህን ዘርግተህ አጥንቱንና ሥጋውን ዳብስ፤ በእውነት በፊትህ ይሰድብሃል አለው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thine hand; but save his life.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔም ሰይጣንን። ሕይወቱን ተወው እንጂ እነሆ፥ እርሱ በእጅህ ነው አለው።

verses.en: So went Satan forth from the presence of YAHUAH, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.
verses.am: ሰይጣንም ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወጣ፥ ኢዮብንም ከእግሩ ጫማ ጀምሮ እስከ አናቱ ድረስ በክፉ ቍስል መታው።

verses.en: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.
verses.am: ሥጋውንም ይፍቅበት ዘንድ ገል ወሰደ፥ በአመድም ላይ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse YAHUAH, and die.
verses.am: ሚስቱም። እስከ አሁን ፍጹምነትህን ይዘሃልን? እግዚአብሔርን ስደብና ሙት አለችው።  (የሚቀጥለው ከግሪክ የተጨመረ ነው)  ዳግመኛ እግዚአብሔርን ጥቂት ወራት ደጅ እጠናዋለሁ፤ ዳግመኛም መከራውን እታገሠዋለሁ፥ የቀድሞ ኑሮዬንም ተስፋ አደርገዋለሁ ትላለህን? አለችው። እንደዚህሳ እንዳትል ከዚህ ዓለም እነሆ ስም አጠራርህ ጠፋ፤ ሴቶች ልጆቼና ወንዶች ልጆቼም ሞቱ እኔስ ዘጠኝ ወር ሳረግዝ ሳምጥ ስወልድ ሳይረቡኝ ሳይጠቅሙኝ በከንቱ ደከምሁ አለች። አንተም በመግል ተውጠህ በትል ተከብበህ ትኖራለህ፤ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ ስትዛብር ታድራለህ። እኔ ግን እየዞርሁ እቀላውጣለሁ። ከአንዱ አገር ወደ አንዱ አገር ከአንዱ ቤት ወደ አንዱ ቤት እሄዳለሁ፤ ከድካሜ በእኔ ላይ ካለ ከችግሬም አርፍ ዘንድ ከጧት ጀምሮ ፀሐይ እስኪገባ ድረስ እጠብቃለሁ፤ አሁን ግን እግዚአብሔርን የማይገባ ቃል ተናግረኸው ሙት አለች።

verses.en: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of YAHUAH, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን አንቺ ከሰነፎች ሴቶች እንደ አንዲቱ ተናገርሽ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር እጅ መልካሙን ተቀበልን፥ ክፉ ነገርንስ አንቀበልምን? አላት። በዚህ ሁሉ ኢዮብ በከንፈሩ አልበደለም።

verses.en: Now when Job's three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.
verses.am: ሦስቱም የኢዮብ ወዳጆች ይህን የደረሰበትን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ ሰምተው ከየአገራቸው መጡ፤ እነርሱም ቴማናዊው ኤልፋዝ፥ ሹሐዊው በልዳዶስ፥ ነዕማታዊው ሶፋር ነበሩ። እነርሱም ሊያዝኑለትና ሊያጽናኑት በአንድነት ወደ እርሱ ለመምጣት ተስማሙ።

verses.en: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.
verses.am: ከሩቅም ሆነው ዓይናቸውን ባነሡ ጊዜ አላወቁትም፤ ድምፃቸውንም አሰምተው አለቀሱ፤ እያንዳንዳቸውም መጐናጸፊያቸውን ቀደዱ፥ ወደ ላይም ወደ ራሳቸው ላይ ትቢያ ነሰነሱ።

verses.en: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.
verses.am: ሰባት ቀንና ሰባት ሌሊትም ከእርሱ ጋር በምድር ላይ ተቀመጡ፤ ሕመሙም እጅግ እንደ በዛ አይተዋልና ከእነርሱ አንድ ቃል የሚናገረው አልነበረም።

verses.en: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ኢዮብ አፉን ከፍቶ የተወለደበትን ቀን ረገመ።

verses.en: And Job spake, and said,
verses.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህ አለ።

verses.en: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.
verses.am: ያ የተወለድሁበት ቀን ይጥፋ፥  ያም። ወንድ ልጅ ተፀነሰ የተባለበት ሌሊት።

verses.en: Let that day be darkness; let not YAHUAH regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.
verses.am: ያ ቀን ጨለማ ይሁን፤  እግዚአብሔር ከላይ አይመልከተው፥  ብርሃንም አይብራበት።

verses.en: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.
verses.am: ጨለማና የሞት ጥላ የራሳቸው ገንዘብ ያድርጉት፤  ዳመናም ይረፍበት፤  የቀን ጨለማ ሁሉ ያስፈራው።

verses.en: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.
verses.am: ያን ሌሊት ጨለማ ይያዘው፤  በዓመቱ ቀኖች መካከል ደስ አይበለው፤  በወሮች ውስጥ ገብቶ አይቈጠር።

verses.en: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ያ ሌሊት መካን ይሁን፤  እልልታ አይግባበት።

verses.en: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.
verses.am: ሌዋታንን ለማንቀሳቀስ የተዘጋጁ  ቀኑን የሚረግሙ ይርገሙት።

verses.en: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:
verses.am: አጥቢያ ኮከቦች ይጨልሙ፤  ብርሃንን ቢጠባበቅ አያግኘው፥  የንጋትንም ቅንድብ አይይ፤

verses.en: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother's womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.
verses.am: የእናቴን ማኅፀን ደጅ አልዘጋምና፥  መከራንም ከዓይኔ አልሰወረምና።

verses.en: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?
verses.am: በማኅፀን ሳለሁ ስለ ምን አልሞትሁም?  ከሆድስ በወጣሁ ጊዜ ፈጥኜ ስለ ምን አልጠፋሁም?

verses.en: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?
verses.am: ጕልበቶች ስለ ምን ተቀበሉኝ?  ጡትስ ስለ ምን ጠባሁ?

verses.en: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,
verses.am: አሁን ተኝቼ ዝም ባልሁ ነበር፤  አንቀላፍቼ ባረፍሁ ነበር፤

verses.en: With kings and counsellors of the earth, which built desolate places for themselves;
verses.am: የፈረሰውን ለራሳቸው ከሚሠሩት  ከምድር ነገሥታትና መካሮች ጋር፥

verses.en: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:
verses.am: ወይም ቤታቸውን ብር ከሞሉ  ወርቅም ካላቸው መኳንንት ጋር፥

verses.en: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.
verses.am: ወይም እንደ ተቀበረ ጭንጋፍ፥  ብርሃንም እንዳላዩ ሕፃናት በሆንሁ ነበር።

verses.en: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.
verses.am: ክፉዎች በዚያ መናደዳቸውን ይተዋሉ፤  በዚያም ደካሞች ያርፋሉ።

verses.en: There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.
verses.am: በዚያ ግዞተኞች በአንድነት ተዘልለው ተቀምጠዋል፤  የአስጨናቂውን ድምፅ አይሰሙም።

verses.en: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.
verses.am: ታናሽና ታላቅ በዚያ አሉ፤  ባሪያም ከጌታው ነጻ ወጥቶአል።

verses.en: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;
verses.am: በመከራ ላሉት ብርሃን፥  ነፍሳቸው መራራ ለሆነችባቸው፥

verses.en: Which long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;
verses.am: የተሰወረ ሀብትን ከሚቈፍሩ ይልቅ  ሞትን ለሚጠብቁ ለማያገኙትም፥

verses.en: Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
verses.am: መቃብርን ባገኙ ጊዜ  በእልልታ ደስ ለሚላቸው፥ ሐሤትንም ለሚያደርጉ  ሕይወት ስለ ምን ተሰጠ?

verses.en: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom YAHUAH hath hedged in?
verses.am: መንገዱ ለተሰወረበት ሰው፥  እግዚአብሔርም በአጥር ላጠረው  ብርሃን ስለ ምን ተሰጠ?

verses.en: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.
verses.am: ከእንጀራዬ በፊት ልቅሶዬ መጥቶአልና፥  ጩኸቴም እንደ ውኃ ፈስሶአል።

verses.en: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
verses.am: የፈራሁት ነገር መጥቶብኛልና፥  የደነገጥሁበትም ደርሶብኛል።

verses.en: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.
verses.am: ተዘልዬ አልተቀመጥሁም፥ አልተማመንሁም፥ አላረፍሁም፤  ነገር ግን መከራ መጣብኝ።

verses.en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.am: ቴማናዊውም ኤልፋዝ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?
verses.am: አንድ ሰው ከአንተ ጋር ይናገር ዘንድ ቢሞክር ትቀየማለህን?  ቃልንስ ከመናገር ሊቀር የሚችል ማን ነው?

verses.en: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አንተ ብዙዎችን ታስተምር ነበር፥  የደከሙትንም እጆች ታበረታ ነበር፥

verses.en: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.
verses.am: ቃልህ የሚሰናከለውን ያስነሣ ነበር፥  አንተም የሚብረከረከውን ጕልበት ታጸና ነበር።

verses.en: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.
verses.am: አሁን ግን በአንተ ላይ መጥቶአል፥ አንተም ደከምህ፤  ደርሶብሃል፥ አንተም ተቸገርህ።

verses.en: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?
verses.am: አምላክህን መፍራትህ መጽናናትህ፥  የቅንነትህም መንገድ ተስፋህ አይደለምን?

verses.en: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?
verses.am: እባክህ አስብ፥ ንጹሕ ሆኖ የጠፋ ማን ነው?  ከልበ ቅንስ የተደመሰሰ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.
verses.am: እኔ እንዳየሁ፥ ኃጢአትን የሚያርሱ፥  መከራንም የሚዘሩ ይህንኑ ያጭዳሉ።

verses.en: By the blast of YAHUAH they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር እስትንፋስ ይጠፋሉ፥  በቍጣውም መንፈስ ያልቃሉ።

verses.en: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
verses.am: የአንበሳ ጩኸት፥ የጩዋኺ አንበሳ ድምፅ፥  የአንበሳ ደቦል ጥርስ ተሰባበረ።

verses.en: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion's whelps are scattered abroad.
verses.am: አሮጌ አንበሳ አደን በማጣት ይሞታል፥  የአንበሳይቱም ግልገሎች ይበተናሉ።

verses.en: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.
verses.am: ለእኔም በምሥጢር ቃል መጣልኝ፥  ጆሮዬም ሹክሹክታውን ሰማች።

verses.en: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,
verses.am: በሌሊት ሕልም አሳብ ሲነሣ፥  የከበደም እንቅልፍ በሰው ላይ ሲወድቅ፥

verses.en: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.
verses.am: አጥንቴን ሁሉ ያናወጡ  ድንጋጤና መንቀጥቀጥ ወደቁብኝ።

verses.en: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:
verses.am: መንፈስም በፊቴ አለፈ፤  የሥጋዬ ጠጕር ቆመ።

verses.en: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,
verses.am: እርሱም ቆመ፥ መልኩን ግን ለመለየት አልቻልሁም፥  ምሳሌም በዓይኔ ፊት ነበረ፤  የዝምታ ድምፅ ሰማሁ።

verses.en: Shall mortal man be more just than YAHUAH? shall a man be more pure than his maker?
verses.am: በውኑ ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጻድቅ ሊሆን፥  ወይስ ሰው በፈጣሪው ፊት ሊነጻ ይችላልን?

verses.en: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በባሪያዎቹ አይታመንም፤  መላእክቱንም ስንፍና ይከስሳቸዋል፤

verses.en: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?
verses.am: ይልቁንስ በጭቃ ቤት የሚኖሩ፥  መሠረታቸው በትቢያ ውስጥ የሆነ፥  ከብል በፊት የሚጨፈለቁ እንዴት ይሆኑ?

verses.en: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.
verses.am: በጥዋትና በማታ መካከል ይሰባበራሉ፤  ማንም ሳያስብ ለዘላለም ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.
verses.am: ገመዳቸው የተነቀለ አይደለምን?  አለጥበብም ይሞታሉ።

verses.en: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?
verses.am: አሁንም ጥራ፤ የሚመልስልህ አለን?  ከቅዱሳንስ ወደማናቸው ትዞራለህ?

verses.en: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.
verses.am: ሰነፉን ሰው ቍጣ ይገድለዋል፥  ሰነፉንም ቅንዓት ያጠፋዋል።

verses.en: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
verses.am: ሰነፍ ሰው ሥር ሰድዶ አየሁት፥  ድንገትም መኖሪያውን ረገምሁ።

verses.en: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.
verses.am: ልጆቹም ከደኅንነት ርቀዋል፥  በበርም ውስጥ ተረግጠዋል፥  የሚታደጋቸውም የለም።

verses.en: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.
verses.am: የሰበሰበውንም ራብተኛ ይበላዋል፥  ከእሾህም ውስጥ እንኳ ያወጣዋል፤  የተጠማ ሀብታቸውን ዋጠ።

verses.en: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;
verses.am: ችግር ከትቢያ አይመጣም፥  መከራም ከመሬት አይበቅልም፤

verses.en: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
verses.am: የአሞራ ግልገሎች ግን ወደ ላይ እየበረሩ ከፍ እንዲሉ፥  ሰው እንዲሁ ለመከራ ተወልዶአል።

verses.en: I would seek unto YAHUAH, and unto YAHUAH would I commit my cause:
verses.am: እኔ ግን እግዚአብሔርን እለምን ነበር፥  ነገሬንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር አቀርብ ነበር።

verses.en: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:
verses.am: የማይመረመረውን ታላቅ ነገርና  የማይቈጠረውን ተአምራት ያደርጋል።

verses.en: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:
verses.am: በምድር ላይ ዝናብን ይሰጣል፥  በእርሻም ላይ ውኃ ይልካል።

verses.en: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.
verses.am: የተዋረዱትን ወደ ላይ ያወጣል፥  ኀዘንተኞችንም ለደኅንነት ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋቸዋል።

verses.en: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.
verses.am: እጃቸውም ምክራቸውን እንዳይፈጽም  የተንኰለኞችን አሳብ ከንቱ ያደርገዋል።

verses.en: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
verses.am: ጠቢባንን በተንኰላቸው ይይዛቸዋል፤  የጠማሞችንም ምክር ይዘረዝራል።

verses.en: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
verses.am: በቀን ጨለማን ያገኛሉ፥  በቀትርም ጊዜ በሌሊት እንዳሉ ይርመሰመሳሉ።

verses.en: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.
verses.am: ድሀውንም ከአፋቸው ሰይፍ  ከኃያሉም እጅ ያድነዋል።

verses.en: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
verses.am: ለምስኪኑም ተስፋ አለው፤  ክፋት ግን አፍዋን ትዘጋለች።

verses.en: Behold, happy is the man whom YAHUAH correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር የሚገሥጸው ሰው ምስጉን ነው፤  ስለዚህ ሁሉን የሚችለውን የአምላክን ተግሣጽ አትናቅ።

verses.en: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.
verses.am: እርሱ ይሰብራል፥ ይጠግንማል፤  ያቈስላል፥ እጆቹም ይፈውሳሉ።

verses.en: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
verses.am: በስድስት ክፉ ነገር ውስጥ ያድንሃል፥  በሰባትም ውስጥ ክፋት አትነካህም።

verses.en: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.
verses.am: በራብ ጊዜ ከሞት፥  በሰልፍም ከሰይፍ እጅ ያድንሃል።

verses.en: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.
verses.am: ከምላስ ጅራፍ ትሰወራለህ፤  ጥፋትም ሲመጣ አትፈራም።

verses.en: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
verses.am: በጥፋትና በራብ ላይ ትስቃለህ፤  ከምድረ በዳ አራዊትም አትፈራም፤

verses.en: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳንህ ከምድረ በዳ ድንጋይ ጋር ይሆናልና፤  የምድረ በዳም አራዊት ከአንተ ጋር ይስማማሉና።

verses.en: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.
verses.am: ድንኳንህም በሰላም እንዲሆን ታውቃለህ፤  በረትህን ትጐበኛለህ አንዳችም አይጐድልብህም።

verses.en: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.
verses.am: ዘርህም ታላቅ እንዲሆን፥  ትውልድህም እንደ ምድር ሣር እንዲሆን ታውቃለህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.
verses.am: በወራቱ የእህሉ ነዶ ወደ አውድማ እንዲገባ፥  በረጅም ዕድሜ ወደ መቃብር ትገባለህ።

verses.en: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ይህችን መረመርን፥ የሰማነውም ይህ ነው፤  አንተ ግን አንዳች ሠርተህ እንደ ሆነ ለራስህ እወቀው።

verses.en: But Job answered and said,
verses.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!
verses.am: ትካዜዬ ምነው በተመዘነ ኖሮ!  መከራዬም ሁሉ ምነው በሚዛን ላይ በተደረገ ኖሮ!

verses.en: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.
verses.am: ከባሕር አሸዋ ይልቅ ይከብድ ነበርና፤  ስለዚህ ቃሌ ደፋር ሆኖአል።

verses.en: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of YAHUAH do set themselves in array against me.
verses.am: ሁሉን የሚችል የአምላክ ፍላጻ በሥጋዬ ውስጥ ነው፥  መርዙንም ነፍሴ ትጠጣለች፤  የእግዚአብሔር ድንጋጤ በላዬ ተሰልፎአል።

verses.en: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?
verses.am: በውኑ የሜዳ አህያ ሣር ሳለው ይጮኻልን?  ወይስ በሬ ገለባ ሳለው ይጮኻልን?

verses.en: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
verses.am: የማይጣፍጥስ ነገር ያለ ጨው ይበላልን?  ወይስ የእንቁላል ውኃ ይጥማልን?

verses.en: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.
verses.am: ሰውነቴ ትነካው ዘንድ እንቢ አለችው፤  እንደሚያስጸይፍ መብል ሆነብኝ።

verses.en: Oh that I might have my request; and that YAHUAH would grant me the thing that I long for!
verses.am: ልመናዬ ምነው በደረሰልኝ!  እግዚአብሔርም ምኞቴን ምነው በሰጠኝ!

verses.en: Even that it would please YAHUAH to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ያደቀኝ ዘንድ  እጁንም ለቅቆ ያጠፋኝ ዘንድ ወድዶ ቢሆን ኖሮ!

verses.en: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.
verses.am: መጽናናት በሆነልኝ ነበር፤  በማይራራ ሕመም ሐሤት ባደረግሁ ነበር፥  የቅዱሱን ቃል አልካድሁምና።

verses.en: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is mine end, that I should prolong my life?
verses.am: እጠብቅ ዘንድ ጕልበቴ ምንድር ነው?  እታገሥም ዘንድ ፍጻሜዬ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?
verses.am: ጕልበቴ የድንጋይ ጕልበት ነውን?  ሥጋዬስ እንደ ናስ ነውን?

verses.en: Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?
verses.am: በውኑ ረድኤት በእኔ እንደሌለ  ጥበብም ሁሉ ከእኔ ዘንድ እንደ ተባረረ አይደለምን?

verses.en: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.
verses.am: ሁሉን የሚችለውን የአምላክን መፍራት  ለሚተው፥ ለመዛል ለቀረበው ስንኳ  ወዳጁ ቸርነትን ሊያሳይ ይገባል።

verses.en: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, and as the stream of brooks they pass away;
verses.am: ወንድሞቼ እንደ ፈፋ፥  እንደሚያልፍ ፈፋ ሐሰተኞች ሆኑብኝ።

verses.en: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:
verses.am: ከበረዶ የተነሣ ደፈረሱ፥  አመዳይም ተሰወረባቸው፤

verses.en: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
verses.am: ፀሐይ በተኰሰች ጊዜ ይደርቃሉ፤  በሙቀትም ጊዜ ከስፍራቸው ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.
verses.am: በየዳርቻቸውም የሚሄዱ ነጋዴዎች ፈቀቅ ይላሉ፤  ወደ በረሃ ወጥተው ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.
verses.am: የቴማን ነጋዴዎች ተመለከቱ፥  የሳባ መንገደኞችም ተጠባበቁአቸው።

verses.en: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.
verses.am: ተስፋ አድርገዋቸው ነበርና አፈሩ፤  ወደዚያ ደረሱ፥ እፍረትም ያዛቸው።

verses.en: For now ye are nothing; ye see my casting down, and are afraid.
verses.am: አሁንም እናንተ እንደዚሁ ሆናችኋል፤  መከራዬን አይታችሁ ፈራችሁ።

verses.en: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?
verses.am: በውኑ። አንዳች ነገር አምጡልኝ፤  ወይስ። ከብልጥግናችሁ ስጦታ አቅርቡልኝ፤

verses.en: Or, Deliver me from the enemy's hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?
verses.am: ወይስ። ከጠላቴ እጅ አስጥሉኝ፤  ወይስ። ከአስጨናቂው እጅ አድኑኝ አልኋችሁን?

verses.en: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.
verses.am: አስተምሩኝ፥ እኔም ዝም እላለሁ፤  የተሳሳትሁትንም ንገሩኝ።

verses.en: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?
verses.am: የቅንነት ቃል እንዴት ኃይለኛ ነው!  የእናንተ ሙግት ግን ምን ይገሥጻል?

verses.en: Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?
verses.am: ተስፋ የሌለው ሰው ንግግር እንደ ነፋስ ነውና  ቃሌን ትገሥጹ ዘንድ ታስባላችሁን?

verses.en: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig a pit for your friend.
verses.am: በድሀ አደጉ ላይ ዕጣ ትጣጣላላችሁ፤  ለወዳጆቻችሁም ጕድጓድ ትቈፍራላችሁ።

verses.en: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እባካችሁ፥ ወደ እኔ ተመልከቱ፤  በፊታችሁም ሐሰት አልናገርም።

verses.en: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.
verses.am: እባካችሁ፥ ተመለሱ፤ በደል አይሁን፤  ጽድቄ በዚህ ነገር ነውና አንድ ጊዜ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?
verses.am: በውኑ በአንደበቴ በደል ይገኛልን?  አፌስ ተንኰልን ይለይ ዘንድ አይችልምን?

verses.en: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? are not his days also like the days of an hireling?
verses.am: በምድር ላይ የሰው ሕይወት ብርቱ ሰልፍ አይደለምን?  ወራቱም እንደ ምንደኛ ወራት አይደለምን?

verses.en: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:
verses.am: አገልጋይ ጥላ እንደሚመኝ፥  ምንደኛም ደመወዙን እንደሚጠብቅ፥

verses.en: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ዕጣዬ የከንቱ ወራት ሆነብኝ፥  የድካምም ሌሊት ተወሰነችልኝ።

verses.en: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.
verses.am: በተኛሁ ጊዜ። መቼ እነሣለሁ? እላለሁ።  ሌሊቱ ግን ይረዝማል፥  እስኪነጋ ድረስም እገለባበጣለሁ።

verses.en: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.
verses.am: ሥጋዬ ትልና ጓል ለብሶአል፤  ቁርበቴ ያፈከፍካል እንደ ገናም ይመግላል።

verses.en: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.
verses.am: ዘመኔ ከሸማኔ መወርወርያ ይልቅ ይቸኵላል፥  ያለ ተስፋም ያልቃል።

verses.en: O remember that my life is wind: mine eye shall no more see good.
verses.am: ሕይወቴ እስትንፋስ እንደ ሆነ አስብ፤  ዓይኔ መልካም ነገርን ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አያይም።

verses.en: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.
verses.am: የሚያየኝ ሰው ዓይን ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አያየኝም፤  ዓይንህ በእኔ ላይ ይሆናል፥ እኔም አልገኝም።

verses.en: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.
verses.am: ደመና ተበትኖ እንደሚጠፋ፥  እንዲሁ ወደ ሲኦል የሚወርድ ዳግመኛ አይወጣም።

verses.en: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.
verses.am: ወደ ቤቱ ዳግመኛ አይመለስም፥  ስፍራውም ዳግመኛ አያውቀውም።

verses.en: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.am: ስለዚህም አፌን አልከለክልም፤  በመንፈሴ ጭንቀትን እናገራለሁ፤  በነፍሴ ምሬት በኀዘን አንጐራጕራለሁ።

verses.en: Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?
verses.am: ጠባቂ ታስነሣብኝ ዘንድ፥  እኔ ባሕር ወይስ አንበሪ ነኝን?

verses.en: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;
verses.am: እኔም። አልጋዬ ያጽናናኛል፥  መኝታዬም የኀዘን እንጕርጕሮዬን ያቀልልኛል ባልሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:
verses.am: አንተ በሕልም ታስፈራራኛለህ፥  በራእይም ታስደነግጠኛለህ፤

verses.en: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.
verses.am: ነፍሴም ከአጥንቴ ይልቅ  መታነቅንና ሞትን መረጠች።

verses.en: I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.
verses.am: ሕይወቴን ናቅኋት፤ ለዘላለም ልኖር አልወድድም።  የሕይወቴ ዘመን እስትንፋስ ነውና ተወኝ።

verses.en: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?
verses.am: ሰው ምንድር ነው ታከብረው ዘንድ፥  ልብህንስ ትጥልበት ዘንድ፥

verses.en: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and try him every moment?
verses.am: ማለዳ ማለዳስ ትጐበኘው ዘንድ፥  ሁልጊዜስ ትፈታተነው ዘንድ?

verses.en: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
verses.am: የማትተወኝ እስከ መቼ ነው?  ምራቄንስ እስክውጥ ድረስ የማትለቅቀኝ እስከ መቼ ነው?

verses.en: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?
verses.am: ሰውን የምትጠብቅ ሆይ፥ በድዬስ እንደ ሆነ ምን ላድርግልህ?  ስለ ምን እኔን ለአንተ ዓላማ አደረግኸኝ?  ስለ ምን እኔ ሸክም ሆንሁብህ?

verses.en: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I shall not be.
verses.am: ስለ ምን መተላለፌን ይቅር አትልም?  ኃጢአቴንስ ስለ ምን አታስወግድልኝም?  አሁን በምድር ውስጥ እተኛለሁ፤  ማለዳ ትፈልገኛለህ፥ አታገኘኝም።

verses.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.am: ሹሐዊውም በልዳዶስ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: How long wilt thou speak these things? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?
verses.am: እስከ መቼ ይህን ትናገራለህ?  የአፍህስ ቃል እስከ መቼ እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ይሆናል?

verses.en: Doth YAHUAH pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?
verses.am: በውኑ እግዚአብሔር ፍርድን ያጣምማልን?  ሁሉንም የሚችል አምላክ ጽድቅን ያጣምማልን?

verses.en: If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;
verses.am: ልጆችህ በድለውት እንደ ሆነ፥  እርሱ በበደላቸው እጅ ጥሎአቸዋል።

verses.en: If thou wouldest seek unto YAHUAH betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ብትገሠግሥ፥  ሁሉንም የሚችለውን አምላክ ብትለምን፥

verses.en: If thou wert pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.
verses.am: ንጹሕና ቅን ብትሆን፥  በእውነት አሁን ስለ አንተ ይነቃል፥  የጽድቅህንም መኖሪያ ያከናውንልሃል።

verses.en: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
verses.am: ጅማሬህ ታናሽ ቢሆንም እንኳ  ፍጻሜህ እጅግ ይበዛል።

verses.en: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:
verses.am: ዘመናችን በምድር ላይ እንደ ጥላ ነውና  እኛ የትናንት ብቻ ነን፤ ምንም አናውቅም፤  ስለዚህ የቀደመውን ትውልድ ጠይቅ፥  አባቶቻቸውም ለመረመሩት ነገር ትጋ፤

verses.en: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)
verses.am: ዘመናችን በምድር ላይ እንደ ጥላ ነውና  እኛ የትናንት ብቻ ነን፤ ምንም አናውቅም፤  ስለዚህ የቀደመውን ትውልድ ጠይቅ፥  አባቶቻቸውም ለመረመሩት ነገር ትጋ፤

verses.en: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?
verses.am: እነርሱ የሚያስተምሩህና የሚነግሩህ፥  ቃልንም ከልባቸው የሚያወጡ አይደሉምን?

verses.en: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
verses.am: በውኑ ደንገል ረግረግ በሌለበት መሬት ይበቅላልን?  ወይስ ቄጠማ ውኃ በሌለበት ቦታ ይለመልማልን?

verses.en: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.
verses.am: ገና ሲለመልም ሳይቈረጥም፥  ከአትክልት ሁሉ በፊት ይደርቃል።

verses.en: So are the paths of all that forget YAHUAH; and the hypocrite's hope shall perish:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የሚረሱ ሁሉ ፍጻሜአቸው እንዲሁ ነው፤  የዝንጉም ሰው ተስፋ ይጠፋል።

verses.en: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider's web.
verses.am: ተስፋው ይቈረጣል፥  እምነቱም እንደ ሸረሪት ቤት ይሆናል።

verses.en: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
verses.am: ቤቱን ይደግፈዋል፥ አይቆምለትም፤  ይይዘውማል፥ አይጸናለትም።

verses.en: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
verses.am: ፀሐይም ሳይተኵስ ይለመልማል፥  ጫፉም በአታክልቱ ቦታ ይወጣል።

verses.en: His roots are wrapped about the heap, and seeth the place of stones.
verses.am: በድንጋይ ክምር ላይ ሥሩ ይጠመጠማል፤  የድንጋዮቹን ቦታ ይመለከታል።

verses.en: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.
verses.am: ከቦታው ቢጠፋ።  አላየሁህም ብሎ ይክደዋል።

verses.en: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የመንገዱ ደስታ እንዲህ ነው፤  ሌሎችም ከመሬት ይበቅላሉ።

verses.en: Behold, YAHUAH will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ፍጹሙን ሰው አይጥለውም፥  የኃጢአተኞችንም እጅ አያበረታም።

verses.en: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.
verses.am: አፍህን እንደ ገና ሳቅ ይሞላል፥  ከንፈሮችህንም እልልታ ይሞላል።

verses.en: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.
verses.am: የሚጠሉህ እፍረት ይለብሳሉ፤  የኃጢአተኞችም ድንኳን አይገኝም።

verses.en: Then Job answered and said,
verses.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with YAHUAH?
verses.am: በእውነት እንዲህ እንደ ሆነ አወቅሁ፤  ሰውስ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጻድቅ መሆን እንዴት ይችላል?

verses.en: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.
verses.am: ከእርሱ ጋር ይከራከር ዘንድ ቢወድድ፥  ከሺህ ነገር አንዱን መመለስ አይችልም።

verses.en: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?
verses.am: ልቡ ጠቢብ፥ ኃይሉም ታላቅ ነው፤  ደፍሮትስ በደኅና የሄደ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.
verses.am: ተራሮችን ይነቅላል፤ አያውቁትም፤  በቍጣውም ይገለብጣቸዋል።

verses.en: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.
verses.am: ምድርን ከስፍራው ያናውጣታል፥  ምሰሶችዋም ይንቀጠቀጣሉ።

verses.en: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.
verses.am: ፀሐይን ያዝዛታል፥ አትወጣምም፤  ከዋክብትንም ያትማል።

verses.en: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.
verses.am: ሰማያትን ብቻውን ይዘረጋል፥  በባሕሩም ማዕበል ላይ ይረግጣል።

verses.en: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.
verses.am: ድብ የሚባለውን ኮከብና ኦሪዮን የሚባለውን ኮከብ፥ ሰባቱንም ከዋክብት፥  በደቡብም በኩል ያሉትን የከዋክብት ማደርያዎች ሠርቶአል።

verses.en: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.
verses.am: የማይመረመረውን ታላላቅ ነገር፥  የማይቈጠረውንም ተአምራት ያደርጋል።

verses.en: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ቢመጣብኝ አላየውም፤  ቢያልፍብኝም አላውቀውም።

verses.en: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ፈጥኖ ቢነጥቅ የሚከለክለው ማን ነው?  እርሱንስ። ምን ታደርጋለህ? የሚለው ማን ነው?

verses.en: If YAHUAH will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ቍጣውን አይመልስም፤  ከእርሱ በታች ረዓብን የሚረዱ ይዋረዳሉ።

verses.en: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?
verses.am: ይልቁንስ እመልስለት ዘንድ፥  ቃሌንስ በፊቱ እመርጥ ዘንድ እኔ ማን ነኝ?

verses.en: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ብሆን ኖሮ አልመልስለትም ነበር፤  ወደ ፈራጄም እለምን ነበር።

verses.en: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
verses.am: ብጠራው እርሱም ቢመልስልኝ ኖሮ፥  ቃሌን እንደ ሰማ አላምንም ነበር።

verses.en: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.
verses.am: በዐውሎ ነፋስ ይሰብረኛል፥  ቍስሌንም ያለ ምክንያት ያበዛል።

verses.en: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.
verses.am: እተነፍስ ዘንድ አይተወኝም፥  ነገር ግን መራራን ነገር አጥግቦኛል።

verses.en: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?
verses.am: የኃይል ነገር ቢሆን እርሱ ኃያል ነው፤  የፍርድ ነገር ቢሆን። ጊዜን ወሳኙ ማን ነው? ይላል።

verses.en: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ብሆን አፌ ይወቅሰኛል፤  ፍጹምም ብሆን ጠማማ ያደርገኛል።

verses.en: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.
verses.am: ፍጹም ነኝ ራሴንም አልመለከትም፤  ሕይወቴንም እንቃታለሁ።

verses.en: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.
verses.am: ይህ ሁሉ አንድ ነው፤ ስለዚህ።  ፍጹማንንና ክፉዎችን ያጠፋል እላለሁ።

verses.en: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.
verses.am: መቅሠፍቱ ፈጥኖ ቢገድል፥  በንጹሐን ፈተና ይሳለቃል።

verses.en: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?
verses.am: ምድር በኃጥአን እጅ ተሰጥታለች፤  የፈራጆችዋን ፊት ሸፍኖአል፤  እርሱ ካልሆነ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.
verses.am: ዘመኔ ከሚሮጥ ሰው ይልቅ ይፈጥናል፤  ይሸሻል፥ መልካምንም አያይም።

verses.en: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.
verses.am: የደንገል ታንኳ እንደሚፈጥን፥  ንስርም ወደ ንጥቂያው እንደሚበርር ያልፋል።

verses.en: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:
verses.am: እኔ። የኀዘን እንጕርጕሮዬን እረሳለሁ፤  ፊቴን መልሼ እጽናናለሁ ብል፥

verses.en: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
verses.am: ንጹሕ እንደማታደርገኝ እኔ አውቃለሁና  ከመከራዬ ሁሉ እፈራለሁ።

verses.en: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?
verses.am: በደለኛ እንደሚሆን ሰው እሆናለሁ፤  ስለ ምንስ በከንቱ እደክማለሁ?

verses.en: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;
verses.am: በአመዳይ ውስጥ ብታጠብ፥  እጆቼንም እጅግ ባነጻ፥

verses.en: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.
verses.am: በአዘቅት ውስጥ ታሰጥመኛለህ፥  ልብሴም ይጸየፈኛል።

verses.en: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.
verses.am: እንድመልስለት አብረን ወደ ፍርድ እንገባ ዘንድ፥  እርሱ እንደ እኔ ሰው አይደለም።

verses.en: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.
verses.am: እጁን በሁለታችን ላይ የሚያኖር ዳኛ  በመካከላችን ምነው በተገኘ!

verses.en: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:
verses.am: በትሩን ከእኔ ላይ ያርቅ፥  ግርማውም አያስፈራኝ፤

verses.en: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.
verses.am: እናገርም ነበር፥ አልፈራውምም ነበር፤  በራሴ እንዲህ አይደለሁምና።

verses.en: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሕይወቴን ሰለቸቻት፤  የኀዘን እንጕርጕሮዬን እለቀዋለሁ፤  በነፍሴም ምሬት እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: I will say unto YAHUAH, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን እንዲህ እለዋለሁ።  አትፍረድብኝ፤ የምትከራከረኝ ለምን እንደ ሆነ ንገረኝ።

verses.en: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?
verses.am: ልታስጨንቅና የእጅህን ሥራ ልትንቅ  የኃጥአንንስ ምክር ልታበራ  በአንተ ዘንድ መልካም ነውን?

verses.en: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?
verses.am: በውኑ የሥጋ ዓይን አለህን?  ወይስ ሰው እንደሚያይ ታያለህን?

verses.en: Are thy days as the days of man? are thy years as man's days,
verses.am: ወይስ ክፋቴን ትፈላለግ ዘንድ፥  ኃጢአቴንም ትመረምር ዘንድ፥  ዘመንህ እንደ ሰው ዘመን ነውን?  ወይስ ዓመታትህ እንደ ሰው ዓመታት ናቸውን?

verses.en: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?
verses.am: ወይስ ክፋቴን ትፈላለግ ዘንድ፥  ኃጢአቴንም ትመረምር ዘንድ፥  ዘመንህ እንደ ሰው ዘመን ነውን?  ወይስ ዓመታትህ እንደ ሰው ዓመታት ናቸውን?

verses.en: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.
verses.am: ከዚህም በላይ በደለኛ እንዳልሆንሁ፥  ከእጅህም የሚያድን እንደሌለ አንተ ታውቃለህ።

verses.en: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.
verses.am: እጅህ ለወሰችኝ ሠራችኝም፤  ከዚያም በኋላ ዞረህ ታጠፋኝ ዘንድ ፈለግህ።

verses.en: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?
verses.am: እንደ ጭቃ አድርገህ እንደ ለወስኸኝ አስብ፤  ወደ ትቢያም ትመልሰኛለህን?

verses.en: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?
verses.am: በውኑ እንደ ወተት አላፈሰስኸኝምን?  እንደ እርጎስ አላረጋኸኝምን?

verses.en: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.
verses.am: ቁርበትና ሥጋ አለበስኸኝ፥  በአጥንትና በጅማትም አጠንከርኸኝ።

verses.en: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
verses.am: ሕይወትና ቸርነት አደረግህልኝ፤  መጐብኘትህም መንፈሴን ጠበቀች።

verses.en: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.
verses.am: እነዚህንም ነገሮች በልብህ ውስጥ ሰወርህ።  ይህ ሁሉ በአሳብህ እንዳለ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.
verses.am: ኃጢአት ብሠራ አንተ ትመለከተኛለህ፤  ከኃጢአቴም ንጹሕ አታደርገኝም።

verses.en: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;
verses.am: በደለኛ ብሆን ወዮልኝ፤  ጻድቅም ብሆን ራሴን አላነሣም፤  ጕስቍልናን ተሞልቻለሁ፥  መከራዬንም ተመልክቻለሁ።

verses.en: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.
verses.am: ራሴም ከፍ ከፍ ቢል እንደ አንበሳ ታድነኛለህ፤  ተመልሰህም ድንቅ ነገር ታድርግብኛለህ

verses.en: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.
verses.am: ምስክሮችህን ታድስብኛለህ፤  ቍጣህንም ታበዛብኛለህ፤  ጭፍራ በጭፍራ ላይ ትጨምርብኛለህ።

verses.en: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!
verses.am: ስለ ምን ከማኅፀን አወጣኸኝ?  ዓይን ሳያየኝ ምነው በሞትሁ።

verses.en: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
verses.am: እንዳልነበረ በሆንሁ፤  ከማኅፀንም ወደ መቃብር በወሰዱኝ።

verses.en: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,
verses.am: የሕይወቴ ዘመን ጥቂት አይደለምን?

verses.en: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;
verses.am: ወደማልመለስበት ስፍራ፥  ወደ ጨለማና ወደ ሞት ጥላ ምድር፥

verses.en: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.
verses.am: እንደ ጨለማም ወደ ጨለመች፥  ሥርዓትም ወደሌለባት ወደ ሞት ጥላ፥  ብርሃንዋም እንደ ጨለማ ወደ ሆነ ምድር ሳልሄድ፥  ጥቂት እጽናና ዘንድ ተወኝ፥ ልቀቀኝም።

verses.en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.am: ነዕማታዊውም ሶፋር መለስ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?
verses.am: በውኑ ለቃል ብዛት መልስ መስጠት አይገባምን?  ወይስ ተናጋሪ ሰው እንደ ጻድቅ ይቈጠራልን?

verses.en: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?
verses.am: ትምክህትህስ ሰዎችን ዝም ያሰኛቸዋልን?  ብትሳለቅስ የሚያሳፍርህ የለምን?

verses.en: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.
verses.am: አንተ። ትምህርቴ የተጣራ ነው፥  በዓይንህም ፊት ንጹሕ ነኝ ትላለህ።

verses.en: But oh that YAHUAH would speak, and open his lips against thee;
verses.am: ምነው እግዚአብሔር ቢናገርህ!  በአንተም ላይ ከንፈሩን ቢከፍት!

verses.en: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that YAHUAH exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.
verses.am: የጥበቡን ምሥጢር ቢገልጥልህ!  ማስተዋሉ ብዙ ነውና።  እግዚአብሔር ለበደልህ ከሚገባው አሳንሶ እንደሚያስከፍልህ እወቅ።

verses.en: Canst thou by searching find out YAHUAH? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ጥልቅ ነገር ልትመረምር ትችላለህን?  ወይስ ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክ ፈጽመህ ልትመረምር ትችላለህን?

verses.en: It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?
verses.am: ከሰማይ ይልቅ ከፍ ይላል፤ ምን ልታደርግ ትችላለህ?  ከሲኦልም ይልቅ ይጠልቃል፤ ምን ልታውቅ ትችላለህ?

verses.en: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
verses.am: ርዝመቱ ከምድር ይልቅ ይረዝማል፥  ከባሕርም ይልቅ ይሰፋል።

verses.en: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?
verses.am: እርሱ ቢያልፍ፥ ቢዘጋም፥ ጉባኤንም ቢሰበስብ፥  የሚከለክለው ማን ነው?

verses.en: For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it?
verses.am: ምናምንቴዎችን ሰዎች ያውቃልና፥  በደልንም ሲያይ ዝም ብሎ አይመለከትም።

verses.en: For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass's colt.
verses.am: የሜዳ አህያ ግልገል ሰው ሆኖ ቢወለድ፥  ያን ጊዜ ከንቱ ሰው ጥበብን ያገኛል።

verses.en: If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ በእውነት ፊትህን ያለ ነውር ታነሣለህ፤  ትበረታለህ፥ አትፈራምም።

verses.en: If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ በእውነት ፊትህን ያለ ነውር ታነሣለህ፤  ትበረታለህ፥ አትፈራምም።

verses.en: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:
verses.am: መከራህንም ትረሳለህ፤  እንዳለፈ ውኃ ታስበዋለህ።

verses.en: Because thou shalt forget thy misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:
verses.am: ከቅትር ይልቅ ሕይወትህ ይበራል፤  ጨለማም ቢሆን እንደ ጥዋት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday; thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.
verses.am: ተስፋም ስላለህ ተዘልለህ ትቀመጣለህ፤  በዙሪያህ ትመለከታለህ፥ በደኅንነትም ታርፋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.
verses.am: ትተኛለህ፥ የሚያስፈራህም የለም፤  ብዙ ሰዎችም ልመና ያቀርቡልሃል።

verses.en: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.
verses.am: የክፉዎች ዓይን ግን ትጨልማለች፤  የሚሸሹበትንም ያጣሉ፥  ተስፋቸውም ነፍሳቸውን ማውጣት ነው።

verses.en: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.
And Job answered and said,
verses.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
verses.am: በእርግጥ እናንተ ዓይነተኞች ሰዎች ናቸሁ፤  ጥበብም ከእናንተ ጋር ይሞታል።

verses.en: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
verses.am: ነገር ግን እኔ ደግሞ እንደ እናንተ ማስተዋል አለኝ፤  ከእናንተም የማንስ አይደለሁም፤  እንደዚህ ያለውን ነገር የማያውቅ ማን ነው?

verses.en: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon YAHUAH, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የጠራሁ እርሱም የመለሰልኝ እኔ  ለባልንጀራው መሳለቂያ እንደሚሆን ሰው ሆኛለሁ፤  ጻድቅና ፍጹም ሰው መሳለቂያ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.
verses.am: ተዘልሎ በሚቀመጥ ሰው አሳብ መከራ ይናቃል፤  ነገር ግን እግሩን ሊያድጠው ተዘጋጅቶአል።

verses.en: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke YAHUAH are secure; into whose hand YAHUAH bringeth abundantly.
verses.am: የቀማኞች ድንኳን በደኅንነት ይኖራል፥  እግዚአብሔርንም የሚያስቈጡ ተዘልለው ተቀምጠዋል፤  እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን በእጃቸው አምጥቶላቸዋል።

verses.en: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:
verses.am: አሁን ግን እንስሶችን ጠይቅ፥ ያስተምሩህማል፤  የሰማይንም ወፎች ጠይቅ፥ ይነግሩህማል።

verses.en: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.
verses.am: ወይም ለምድር ተናገር፥ እርስዋም ታስተምርሃለች፤  የባሕርም ዓሣዎች ይነግሩሃል።

verses.en: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of YAHUAH hath wrought this?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር እጅ ይህን እንዳደረገ  ከእነዚህ ሁሉ የማያውቅ ማን ነው?

verses.en: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
verses.am: የሕያዋን ሁሉ ነፍስ  የሰውም ሁሉ መንፈስ በእጁ ናት።

verses.en: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?
verses.am: ምላስ መብልን እንደሚቀምስ፥  ጆሮ ቃልን የሚለይ አይደለምን?

verses.en: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.
verses.am: በሽምግልና ጊዜ ጥበብ፥  በዘመንስ ርዝመት ማስተዋል ይገኛል።

verses.en: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ጥበብና ኃይል አለ፤  ለእርሱ ምክርና ማስተዋል አለው።

verses.en: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ይፈርሳል፥ የፈረሰውም ተመልሶ አይሠራም፤  በሰውም ቢዘጋበት የሚከፍትለት የለም።

verses.en: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ውኆቹን ይከለክላል፥ እነርሱም ይደርቃሉ፤  እንደ ገና ይሰድዳቸዋል፥ ምድሪቱንም ይገለብጣሉ።

verses.en: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.
verses.am: ኃይልና ጥበብ በእርሱ ዘንድ ናቸው፤  የሚስተውና የሚያስተው ለእርሱ ናቸው።

verses.en: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.
verses.am: መካሮችንም እንደ ዘረፋ ይወስዳቸዋል፥  ፈራጆችንም ያሳብዳል።

verses.en: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.
verses.am: የነገሥታትንም እስራት ይፈታል፥  ወገባቸውንም በመታጠቂያ ያስራቸዋል።

verses.en: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.
verses.am: ካህናትን እንደ ዘረፋ ይወስዳቸዋል፥  ኃያላንንም ይገለብጣቸዋል።

verses.en: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.
verses.am: ከታመኑ ሰዎችም ቋንቋን ያርቃል፥  የሽማግሌዎችንም ማስተዋል ይወስድባቸዋል።

verses.en: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.
verses.am: በአለቆች ላይ ንቀትን ያፈስሳል፥  የብርቱዎችንም መታጠቂያ ያላላል።

verses.en: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
verses.am: ጥልቅ ነገር ከጨለማ ይገልጣል፥  የሞትንም ጥላ ወደ ብርሃን ያወጣል።

verses.en: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.
verses.am: አሕዛብን ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋል፥ እነርሱንም ያጠፋል፤  አሕዛብንም ያሰፋል፥ እነርሱንም ያፈልሳቸዋል።

verses.en: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
verses.am: ከምድር አሕዛብ አለቆች ዘንድ ማስተዋልን ይወስዳል፥  መንገድም በሌለበት በረሃ ያቅበዘብዛቸዋል።

verses.en: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
verses.am: ብርሃንም ሳይኖር በጨለማ ይርመሰመሳሉ፤  እንደ ሰካራም ይቅበዘበዛሉ።

verses.en: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ይህን ሁሉ ዓይኔ አየች፤  ጆሮዬም ሰምታ አስተዋለችው።

verses.en: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.
verses.am: እናንተ የምታውቁትን እኔ ደግሞ አውቃለሁ፤  ከእናንተ የማንስ አይደለሁም።

verses.en: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with YAHUAH.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሁሉን ለሚችል አምላክ መናገር እፈልጋለሁ፥  ከእግዚአብሔርም ጋር ለመዋቀስ እሻለሁ።

verses.en: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን በሐሰት ለባጮች ናችሁ፤  ሁላችሁ የማትጠቅሙ ባለ መድኃኒቶች ናችሁ።

verses.en: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.
verses.am: ምነው ዝም ብላችሁ ብትኖሩ!  ይህ ጥበብ በሆነላችሁ ነበር።

verses.en: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
verses.am: አሁንም ክርክሬን ስሙ፥  የከንፈሬንም ሙግት አድምጡ።

verses.en: Will ye speak wickedly for YAHUAH? and talk deceitfully for him?
verses.am: በውኑ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ሐሰትን ትናገራላችሁን?  ስለ እርሱም ሽንገላን ታወራላችሁን?

verses.en: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for YAHUAH?
verses.am: ለፊቱስ ታደላላችሁን?  ስለ እግዚአብሔርስ ትከራከራላችሁን?

verses.en: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?
verses.am: ቢመረምራችሁስ መልካም ይሆንልችኋልን?  ወይስ በሰው እንደምትሳለቁ ትሳለቁበታላችሁን?

verses.en: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
verses.am: በስውር ለሰው ፊት ብታደሉ  ዘለፋ ይዘልፋችኋል።

verses.en: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?
verses.am: ክብሩስ አያስፈራችሁምን?  ግርማውስ አይወድቅባችሁምን?

verses.en: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.
verses.am: ምስሌዎቻችሁ የአመድ ምሳሌዎች ናቸው፤  ምሽጎቻችሁ የጭቃ ምሽጎች ናቸው።

verses.en: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.
verses.am: ዝም በሉ፥ እናገርም ዘንድ ተዉኝ፤  የሆነው ነገር ይምጣብኝ።

verses.en: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?
verses.am: ሥጋዬን በጥርሴ እይዛለሁ፥  ሕይወቴንም በእጄ አኖራለሁ።

verses.en: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ቢገድለኝ ስንኳ እርሱን በትዕግሥት እጠባበቃለሁ፤  ነገር ግን መንገዴን በፊቱ አጸናለሁ።

verses.en: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
verses.am: ዝንጉ ሰው በፊቱ አይገባምና  እርሱ መድኃኒት ይሆንልኛል።

verses.en: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
verses.am: ነገሬን ተግታችሁ ስሙ፥  ምስክርነቴንም በጆሮአችሁ አድምጡ።

verses.en: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ሙግቴን አዘጋጅቻለሁ።  እንደምጸድቅም አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
verses.am: ከእኔስ ጋር የሚፋረድ ማን ነው?  አሁን እኔ ዝም ብል እሞታለሁ።

verses.en: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሁለት ነገር አታድርግብኝ፤  የዚያን ጊዜ ከፊትህ አልሰወርም፤

verses.en: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.
verses.am: እጅህን ከእኔ አርቅ፤  ግርማህም አታስደንግጠኝ።

verses.en: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ጥራኝ፥ እኔም እመልስልሃለሁ።  ወይም እኔ ልናገር፥ አንተም መልስልኝ።

verses.en: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.
verses.am: ያለብኝስ በደልና ኃጢአት ምን ያህል ነው?  መተላለፌንና ኃጢአቴን አስታውቀኝ።

verses.en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?
verses.am: ፊትህን ከእኔ የሰወርህ፥  እንደ ጠላትህም የቈጠርኸኝ ስለ ምን ነው?

verses.en: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
verses.am: የረገፈውን ቅጠል ታስጨንቃለህን?  ወይስ የደረቀውን ዕብቅ ታሳድዳለህን?

verses.en: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.
verses.am: የመረረ ነገር ጽፈህብኛልና፤  የሕፃንነቴንም ኃጢአት ታወርሰኛለህ።

verses.en: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.
verses.am: እግሬንም በእግር ግንድ አግብተሃል፥  መንገዴንም ሁሉ መርምረሃል፤  የእግሬን ፍለጋ ወስነሃል።

verses.en: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.
verses.am: እኔ እንደሚጠፋ በስባሳ ነገር፥  ብልም እንደሚበላው ልብስ ነኝ።

verses.en: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.
verses.am: ከሴት የተወለደ ሰው  የሕይወቱ ዘመን ጥቂት ቀን ነው፥ መከራም ይሞላዋል።

verses.en: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.
verses.am: እንደ አበባ ይወጣል፥ ይረግፋልም፤  እንደ ጥላም ይሸሻል፥ እርሱም አይጸናም።

verses.en: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?
verses.am: እንደዚህስ ባለ ሰው ላይ ዓይኖችህን ትከፍታለህን?  ከአንተስ ጋር እኔን ወደ ፍርድ ታገባለህን?

verses.en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
verses.am: ከርኩስ ነገር ንጹሕን ሊያወጣ ማን ይችላል?  አንድ እንኳ የሚችል የለም።

verses.en: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
verses.am: የሰው ዕድሜ የተወሰነ ነው፥  የወሩም ቍጥር በአንተ ዘንድ ነው፥  እርሱም ሊተላለፈው የማይችለውን ዳርቻ አደረግህለት።

verses.en: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.
verses.am: እንደ ምንደኛ ዕድሜው እስኪፈጸም ድረስ  ያርፍ ዘንድ ከእርሱ ጥቂት ዘወር በል።

verses.en: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
verses.am: ዛፍ ቢቈረጥ ደግሞ ያቈጠቍጥ ዘንድ፥  ቅርንጫፉም እንዳያልቅ ተስፋ አለው።

verses.en: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;
verses.am: ሥሩም በምድር ውስጥ ቢያረጅ፥  ግንዱም በመሬት ውስጥ ቢሞት፥

verses.en: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.
verses.am: ከውኃ ሽታ የተነሣ ያቈጠቍጣል፤  እንደ አትክልት ቅርንጫፍ ያወጣል።

verses.en: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?
verses.am: ሰው ግን ይሞትና ይጋደማል፤  ሰውም ነፍሱን ይሰጣል፥ እርሱስ ወዴት አለ?

verses.en: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:
verses.am: ውኃ ከባሕር ውስጥ ያልቃል፤  ወንዙም ያንሳል ይደርቅማል።

verses.en: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.
verses.am: ሰውም ተኝቶ አይነሣም፤  ሰማይ እስኪያልፍ ድረስ አይነቃም፥  ከእንቅልፉም አይነሣም።

verses.en: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!
verses.am: በሲኦል ውስጥ ምነው በሰወርኸኝ ኖሮ!  ቍጣህ እስኪያልፍ ድረስ በሸሸግኸኝ ኖሮ!  ቀጠሮም አድርገህ ምነው ባሰብኸኝ ኖሮ!

verses.en: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.
verses.am: በውኑ ሰው ከሞተ ተመልሶ ሕያው ይሆናልን?  መለወጤ እስኪመጣ ድረስ፥  የሰልፌን ዘመን ሁሉ በትዕግሥት በተጠባበቅሁ ነበር።

verses.en: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.
verses.am: በጠራኸኝና በመለስሁልህ ነበር፤  የእጅህንም ሥራ በተመኘኸው ነበር።

verses.en: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?
verses.am: አሁን ግን እርምጃዬን ቈጥረኸዋል፤  ኃጢአቴንም ትጠባበቃለህ።

verses.en: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.
verses.am: መተላልፌ በከረጢት ውስጥ ታትሞአል፥  ኃጢአቴንም ለብጠህበታል።

verses.en: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.
verses.am: ተራራ ሲወድቅ ይጠፋል፥  ዓለቱም ከስፍራው ይፈልሳል፤

verses.en: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.
verses.am: ውኆች ድንጋዮቹን ይፍቃሉ፤  ፈሳሾቹም የምድሩን አፈር ይወስዳሉ፤  እንዲሁ የሰውን ተስፋ ታጠፋዋለህ።

verses.en: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.
verses.am: ለዘላለም ታሸንፈዋለህ፥ እርሱም ያልፋል፤  ፊቱን ትለውጣለህ፥ እርሱንም ትሰድደዋለህ።

verses.en: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.
verses.am: ልጆቹ ቢከብሩ አያውቅም፤  ቢዋረዱም አያይም።

verses.en: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የገዛ ሥጋው ሕመም ብቻ ይሰማዋል፥  ለራሱም ብቻ ያለቅሳል። ች

verses.en: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
verses.am: ቴማናዊውም ኤልፋዝ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?
verses.am: በውኑ ጠቢብ ሰው እንደ ንፋስ በሆነ እውቀት ይመልሳልን?  በሆዱስ የምሥራቅን ነፋስ ይሞላልን?

verses.en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
verses.am: ከማይረባ ነገር፥  ወይስ ከማይጠቅም ንግግር ጋር ይዋቀሳልን?

verses.en: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before YAHUAH.
verses.am: አንተም እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ታፈርሳለህ፤  በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አምልኮን ታስቀራለህ።

verses.en: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
verses.am: በደልህ አፍህን ያስተምረዋል፥  የተንኰለኞችንም አንደበት ትመርጣለህ።

verses.en: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
verses.am: የሚፈርድብህ አፍህ ነው እንጂ እኔ አይደለሁም።  ከንፈሮችህም ይመሰክሩብሃል።

verses.en: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?
verses.am: በውኑ መጀመሪያ የተወለድህ ሰው አንተ ነህን?  ወይስ ከተራሮች በፊት ተፀነስህን?

verses.en: Hast thou heard the secret of YAHUAH? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንስ ምሥጢር ሰምተሃልን?  ወይስ ጥበብን ለብቻህ አድርገሃልን?

verses.en: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?
verses.am: እኛ የማናውቀውን አንተ የምታወቀው ምንድር ነው?  ከእኛ ዘንድስ የሌለው የምታስተውለው ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.
verses.am: በዕድሜ ከአባትህ የሚበልጡ  ሽበትም ያላቸው ሽማግሌዎችም ከእኛ ጋር አሉ።

verses.en: Are the consolations of YAHUAH small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?
verses.am: በውኑ የእግዚአብሔር ማጽናናት፥  በየውሃትም የተነገረህ ቃል ጥቂት ነውን?

verses.en: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,
verses.am: ልብህስ ለምን ይወስድሃል?  ዓይኖችህስ ለምን ይገለምጣሉ?

verses.en: That thou turnest thy spirit against YAHUAH, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ላይ መንፈስህን እስከ ማንሣት ደርሰህ፤  ይህንም ቃል ከአፍህ እስከ ማውጣት ደርሰህ።

verses.en: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.am: ንጹሕ ይሆን ዘንድ ሰው ምንድር ነው?  ጻድቅስ ይሆን ዘንድ ከሴት የተወለደ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በቅዱሳኑ ስንኳ አይታመንም፤  ሰማያትም በፊቱ ንጹሐን አይደሉም።

verses.en: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?
verses.am: ይልቁንስ አስጸያፊና የረከሰ፥  ኃጢአትንም እንደ ውኃ የሚጠጣ ሰው ምንኛ ያንስ?

verses.en: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;
verses.am: በመካከላቸውም እንግዳ ያልገባባቸው ጠቢባን።  ከአባቶቻቸው ተቀብለው የተናገሩትን ያልሸሸጉትንም፥  እገልጥልሃለሁ፥ ስማኝ፤ ያየሁትንም እነግርሃለሁ።

verses.en: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:
verses.am: በመካከላቸውም እንግዳ ያልገባባቸው ጠቢባን።  ከአባቶቻቸው ተቀብለው የተናገሩትን ያልሸሸጉትንም፥  እገልጥልሃለሁ፥ ስማኝ፤ ያየሁትንም እነግርሃለሁ።

verses.en: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.
verses.am: ክፉ ሰው ዕድሜውን ሙሉ፥  ከግፈኛ በተመደቡለት በዓመታት ሁሉ በሕመም ይጣጣራል።

verses.en: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
verses.am: የሚያስደነግጥ ድምፅ በጆሮው ነው፤  በደኅንነቱም ሳለ ቀማኛ ይመጣበታል።

verses.en: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
verses.am: ከጨለማ ተመልሶ እንዲወጣ አያምንም፥  ሰይፍም ይሸምቅበታል።

verses.en: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.
verses.am: ተቅበዝብዞም። ወዴት አለ? እያለ እንጀራ ይለምናል፤  የጨለማ ቀን እንደ ቀረበበት ያውቃል።

verses.en: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
verses.am: መከራና ጭንቀት ያስፈራሩታል፤  ለሰልፍ እንደ ተዘጋጀ ንጉሥ ያሸንፉታል፤

verses.en: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
verses.am: እጁን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ዘርግቶአልና፥  ሁሉንም በሚችል አምላክ ላይ ደፍሮአልና፥

verses.en: For he stretcheth out his hand against YAHUAH, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.
verses.am: በደንዳና አንገቱና በወፍራሙ በጋሻው  ጕብጕብ እየሠገገ ይመጣበታልና፥

verses.en: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:
verses.am: በስብም ፊቱን ከድኖአልና፥  ስቡንም በወገቡ ላይ አድርጓልና፥

verses.en: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.
verses.am: በተፈቱም ከተሞች ውስጥ፥  ሰውም በሌለባቸው፥  ክምር ለመሆን በተመደቡ ቤቶች ውስጥ ተቀምጦአልና

verses.en: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.
verses.am: ባለጠጋ አይሆንም፥ ሀብቱም አይጸናም፤  ጥላውንም በምድር ላይ አይጥልም፤

verses.en: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.
verses.am: ከጨለማ አይወጣም፤  ነበልባሉም ቅርንጫፎቹን ያደርቃቸዋል፥  አበባዎቹም ይረግፋሉ።

verses.en: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.
verses.am: ዋጋው ከንቱ ነገር ይሆናልና  ራሱን እያሳተ በከንቱ ነገር አይታመን።

verses.en: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.
verses.am: ቀኑ ሳይደርስ ጊዜው ይፈጸማል፥  ቅርንጫፉም አይለመልምም።

verses.en: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.
verses.am: እንደ ወይን ያልበሰለውን ዘለላ ያረግፋል፤  እንደ ወይራ አበባውን ይጥላል።

verses.en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.
verses.am: የዝንጉዎች ጉባኤ ሁሉ ለጥፋት ይሆናል፥  የጉቦ ተቀባዮችንም ድንኳን እሳት ትበላለች።

verses.en: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.
verses.am: ጉዳትን ይፀንሳሉ፥ በደልንም ይወልዳሉ፥  ሆዳቸውም ተንኰልን ያዘጋጃል።

verses.en: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.
Then Job answered and said,
verses.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.
verses.am: እንደዚህ ያለ ዓይነት ነገር እጅግ ሰማሁ፤  እናንተ ሁላችሁ የምታደክሙ አጽናኞች ናችሁ።

verses.en: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?
verses.am: በውኑ ከንቱ ቃል ይፈጸማልን?  ወይስ ትመልስ ዘንድ ያነሣሣህ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul's stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.
verses.am: እኔ ደግሞ እንደ እናንተ እናገር ዘንድ ይቻለኝ ነበር፤  ነፍሳችሁ በነፍሴ ፋንታ ቢሆን ኖሮ፥  እኔ በእናንተ ላይ ቃል ማሳካት፥  ራሴንም በእናንተ ላይ መነቅነቅ በተቻለኝ ነበር።

verses.en: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.
verses.am: በአፌም ነገር ባበረታኋችሁ ነበር፤  የከንፈሬን ማጽናናት ባልከለከልሁም ነበር።

verses.en: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?
verses.am: እኔ ብናገር ሕማሜ አይቀነስም፤  ዝምም ብል ከእኔ አይወገድም።

verses.en: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.
verses.am: አሁን ግን አድክሞኛል፤  ወገኔንም ሁሉ አፍርሰሃል።

verses.en: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.
verses.am: መጨማተሬ ይመሰክርብኛል፤  ክሳቴም ተነሥቶብኛል፤  በፊቴም ይመሰክርብኛል።

verses.en: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
verses.am: በቍጣው ቀደደኝ፥ እርሱም ጠላኝ፤  ጥርሶቹንም አፋጨብኝ፤  ጠላቴ ዓይኑን አፈጠጠብኝ፤

verses.en: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.
verses.am: እነርሱም አፋቸውን ከፈቱብኝ፤  እያላገጡ ጕንጬን ጠፈጠፉኝ፤  በአንድነትም ተሰበሰቡብኝ።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለጠማማ ሰው አሳልፎ ሰጠኝ፥  በክፉዎችም እጅ ጣለኝ።

verses.en: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.
verses.am: ተዘልዬ ተቀምጬ ነበር፥ እርሱም ሰበረኝ፤  አንገቴንም ይዞ ቀጠቀጠኝ፤  እንደ ዓላማ አድርጎ አቆመኝ።

verses.en: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.
verses.am: ቀስተኞቹ ከበቡኝ፤  ኵላሊቴንም ቈራረጠ፥ እርሱም አልራራም፤  ሐሞቴን በምድር ላይ አፈሰሰ።

verses.en: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.
verses.am: በቍስል ላይ ቍስል ጨመረብኝ፤  እንደ ኃያል እየሠገገ ይሮጥብኛል።

verses.en: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.
verses.am: በቁርበቴ ላይ ማቅ ሰፋሁ፥  ቀንዴንም በመሬት ላይ አኖርሁ።

verses.en: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
verses.am: ፊቴ ከልቅሶ የተነሣ ቀላ፤  የሞት ጥላ በዓይኖቼ ቆብ ላይ አለ፤

verses.en: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእጄ ዓመፅ የለም፤  ጸሎቴም ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.en: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.
verses.am: ምድር ሆይ፥ ደሜን አትክደኚ፥  ለጩኸቴም ማረፊያ አይሁን።

verses.en: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ ምስክሬ በሰማይ አለ፥  የሚመሰክርልኝም በአርያም ነው።

verses.en: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: ጸሎቴ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይድረስ፥  ዓይኔም በፊቱ እንባ ታፍስስ።

verses.en: O that one might plead for a man with YAHUAH, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ከባልንጀራው ጋር እንደሚምዋገት፥  ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመምዋገት ምነው በቻለ!

verses.en: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.
verses.am: ጥቂቶች ዓመታት ካለፉ በኋላ  እኔ ወደማልመለስበት መንገድ እሄዳለሁ።

verses.en: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.
verses.am: መንፈሴ ደከመ፥ ዘመኔ አለቀ፥  መቃብርም ተዘጋጅቶልኛል።

verses.en: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?
verses.am: አላጋጮች በእኔ ዘንድ አሉ፥  ዓይኔም በማስቈጣታቸው አደረች።

verses.en: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?
verses.am: አሁንም አንተ መያዣ ሆነህ ተዋሰኝ፤  ከእኔ ጋር አጋና የሚመታ ማን ነው?

verses.en: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.
verses.am: ልባቸውም እንዳያስተውል ከልክለኸዋል፤  ስለዚህ ከፍ ከፍ አታደርጋቸውም።

verses.en: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.
verses.am: ለብዝበዛ ባልንጀሮቹን አሳልፎ የሚሰጥ ሰው፥  የልጆቹ ዓይን ይጨልማል።

verses.en: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.
verses.am: ለሕዝብም ምሳሌ አደረገኝ፤  በፊቱ ላይ ጺቅ እንደሚሉበት ሰው ሆንሁ።

verses.en: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.
verses.am: ዓይኔም ከኀዘን የተነሣ ፈዘዘች፥  ብልቶቼም ሁሉ እንደ ጥላ ሆኑ።

verses.en: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.
verses.am: ቅኖች ሰዎች በዚህ ነገር ይደነቃሉ፥  ንጹሕም በዝንጉው ላይ ይበሳጫል።

verses.en: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ግን መንገዱን ያጠነክራል፥  እጁም ንጹሕ የሆነ ሰው ኃይልን እየጨመረ ይሄዳል።

verses.en: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እናንተ ሁሉ ተመልሳችሁ ወደ እኔ ኑ፤  በእናንተም ዘንድ ብልሃተኛ አላገኝም።

verses.en: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.
verses.am: ዕድሜዬ አለፈች፤  አሳቤና የልቤ መሣርያ ተቈረጠ።

verses.en: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.
verses.am: ሌሊቱን ወደ ቀን ይለውጣሉ፤  ብርሃኑም ወደ ጨለማ የቀረበ ይመስላቸዋል።

verses.en: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
verses.am: ተስፋ ባደርግ ሲኦል ቤቴ ናት፤  ምንጣፌንም በጨለማ ዘርግቻለሁ።

verses.en: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.
verses.am: መበስበስን። አንተ አባቴ ነህ፤  ትልንም። አንቺ እናቴ እኅቴም ነሽ ብያለሁ።

verses.en: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ተስፋዬ ወዴት ነው?  ተስፋዬንስ የሚያይ ማን ነው?

verses.en: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.
verses.am: አብረን በመሬት ውስጥ ስናርፍ፥  ወደ ሲኦል ይወርዳል።

verses.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.am: ሹሐዊውም በልዳዶስ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.
verses.am: እስከ መቼ ቃልን ታጠምዳለህ?  አስተውል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ እንናገራለን።

verses.en: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?
verses.am: ስለ ምንስ እንደ እንስሶች ተቈጠርን?  ስለ ምንስ በዓይንህ ፊት ረከስን?

verses.en: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?
verses.am: ቍጣ ወርሶሃል፤ አንተስ የሞትህ እንደ ሆነ፥  ምድር ስለ አንተ ባድማ ትሆናለችን?  ወይስ ዓለት ከስፍራው ይነቀላልን?

verses.en: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.
verses.am: የኃጢአተኛ መብራት ይጠፋል፥  የእሳቱም ነበልባል ብልጭ አይልም።

verses.en: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.
verses.am: ብርሃን በድንኳኑ ውስጥ ይጨልማል፥  መብራቱም በላዩ ይጠፋል።

verses.en: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.
verses.am: የኃይሉም እርምጃ ትጠብባለች፥  ምክሩም ትጥለዋለች።

verses.en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.
verses.am: እግሩ በወጥመድ ትያዛለች፥  በመረብም ላይ ይሄዳል።

verses.en: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.
verses.am: አሽክላ ሰኰናውን ይይዛል፥  ወስፈንጠርም ይበረታበታል።

verses.en: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ የሸምቀቆ ገመድ፥  በመንገዱም ላይ ወጥመድ ለእርሱ ተሰውራለች።

verses.en: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.
verses.am: ድንጋጤ በዙሪያው ታስፈራዋለች፥  በስተ ኋላውም ሆና ታባርራቸዋለች።

verses.en: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.
verses.am: ኃይሉ በራብ ትደክማለች፥  መቅሠፍትም እስኪሰናከል ተዘጋጅቶለታል።

verses.en: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.
verses.am: የሰውነቱ ብልቶች ይጠፋሉ፤  የሞትም በኵር ልጅ ብልቶቹን ይበላል።

verses.en: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
verses.am: ከሚታመንበት ድንኳን ይነቀላል፤  ወደ ድንጋጤም ንጉሥ ያስቸኵሉታል።

verses.en: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
verses.am: በድንኳኑ ውስጥ ለእርሱ የማይሆነው ይኖራል፤  በመኖሪያውም ላይ ዲን ይበተናል።

verses.en: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
verses.am: ሥሩ ከበታቹ ይደርቃል፥  ጫፉም ከበላይ ይረግፋል።

verses.en: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.
verses.am: መታሰቢያው ከምድር ላይ ይጠፋል፥  በሜዳም ስም አይቀርለትም።

verses.en: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
verses.am: ከብርሃን ወደ ጨለማ ያፈልሱታል፥  ከዓለምም ያሳድዱታል።

verses.en: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.
verses.am: ዘርም ትውልድም በሕዝቡ መካከል አይሆንለትም፤  በመኖሪያውም ውስጥ የሚቀመጥ ሰው አይቀርለትም።

verses.en: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.
verses.am: የፊተኞች ሰዎች እንደ ደነገጡ፥  እንዲሁ የኋለኞች ሰዎች ስለ ዘመኑ ይደነቃሉ።

verses.en: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not YAHUAH.
verses.am: በእውነት የኃጢአተኞች ቤት እንዲሁ ናት፥  እግዚአብሔርንም የማያውቅ ሰው ስፍራ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Then Job answered and said,
verses.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?
verses.am: ነፍሴን የምትነዘንዙ፥  በቃልስ የምታደቅቁኝ እስከ መቼ ነው?

verses.en: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.
verses.am: ይኸው ስትሰድቡኝ አሥር ጊዜ ነው፤  ስታሻክሩኝም አላፈራችሁም።

verses.en: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.
verses.am: በእውነትም የሳትሁ እንደ ሆነ፥  ስሕተቴ ከእኔ ጋር ትኖራለች።

verses.en: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:
verses.am: በእውነትም ብትጓደዱብኝ፥  መዋረዴን በእኔ ላይ ብትከራከሩ፥

verses.en: Know now that YAHUAH hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ገለበጠኝ፥  በመረቡም እንደ ከበበኝ እወቁ።

verses.en: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ስለ ተደረገብኝ ግፍ ብጮኽ ማንም አይመልስልኝም፤  አሰምቼም ብጠራ ፍርድ የለኝም።

verses.en: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.
verses.am: እንዳላልፍ መንገዴን ዘግቶታል፥  በጎዳናዬም ጨለማ አኑሮበታል።

verses.en: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
verses.am: ክብሬን ገፈፈኝ፥  ዘውዴንም ከራሴ ላይ ወሰደ።

verses.en: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
verses.am: በዚህና በዚያም አፈረሰኝ፥ እኔም ሄድሁ፤  ተስፋዬንም እንደ ዛፍ ነቀለው፤

verses.en: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.
verses.am: ቍጣውንም አነደደብኝ፥  እንደ ጠላቱም ቈጠረኝ።

verses.en: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
verses.am: ሠራዊቱ አብረው መጡ፥  መንገዳቸውንም በላዬ አዘጋጁ፥  በድንኳኔም ዙሪያ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
verses.am: ወንድሞቼን ከእኔ ዘንድ አራቀ፥  የሚያውቁኝም አጥብቀው ተለዩኝ።

verses.en: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
verses.am: ዘመዶቼ ተቋረጡ፥  ወዳጆቼም ረሱኝ።

verses.en: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
verses.am: ቤተ ሰቦቼና ሴቶች ባሪያዎቼ እንደ መጻተኛ ቈጠሩኝ፤  በዓይናቸውም እንደ እንግዳ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
verses.am: ባሪያዬን ብጠራ፥ በአፌም ባቈላምጥ አይመልስልኝም።

verses.en: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children's sake of mine own body.
verses.am: ሚስቴ እስትንፋሴን ጠላች፥  የእናቴም ማኅፀን ልጆች ልመናዬን ጠሉ።

verses.en: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
verses.am: ሕፃናቶች እንኳ አጠቁኝ፤  ብነሣም በእኔ ላይ ይናገራሉ።

verses.en: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.
verses.am: አማካሪዎቼ ሁሉ ተጸየፉኝ፤  እኔ የምወድዳቸው በላዬ ተገለበጡ።

verses.en: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
verses.am: አጥንቴ ከቁርበቴና ከሥጋዬ ጋር ተጣበቀ፤  ድድ ብቻ ቀርቶልኝ አመለጥሁ።

verses.en: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of YAHUAH hath touched me.
verses.am: እናንተ ወዳጆቼ ሆይ፥ ማሩኝ፤  የእግዚአብሔር እጅ መትታኛለችና ማሩኝ።

verses.en: Why do ye persecute me as YAHUAH, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.am: ስለ ምን እናንተ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ታሳድዱኛላችሁ?  ከሥጋዬስ ስለ ምን አትጠግቡም?

verses.en: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!
verses.am: ምነው አሁን ቃሌ ቢጻፍ!  ምነው በመጽሐፍ ውስጥ ቢታተም!

verses.en: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
verses.am: ምነው በብረት ብርና በእርሳስ  በዓለቱ ላይ ለዘላለም ቢቀረጽ!

verses.en: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
verses.am: እኔን ግን የሚቤዠኝ ሕያው እንደ ሆነ፥  በመጨረሻም ዘመን በምድር ላይ እንዲቆም፥

verses.en: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see YAHUAH:
verses.am: ይህ ቁርበቴም ከጠፋ በኋላ፥  በዚያን ጊዜ ከሥጋዬ ተለይቼ እግዚአብሔርን እንዳይ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.
verses.am: እኔ ራሴ አየዋለሁ፥  ዓይኖቼም ይመለከቱታል፥  ከእኔም ሌላ አይደለም።  ልቤ በመናፈቅ ዝሎአል።

verses.en: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?
verses.am: በእውነት። እንዴት እናሳድደዋለን?  የነገሩ ሥር በእርሱ ዘንድ ተገኝቶአል ብትሉ፥

verses.en: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.
verses.am: ፍርድ እንዳለ ታውቁ ዘንድ  ቍጣ የሰይፍን ቅጣት ያመጣልና  ከሰይፍ ፍሩ።

verses.en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.am: ናዕማታዊውም ሶፋር መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በውስጤ ስላለው ችኰላ አሳቤ ትመልስልኛለች።

verses.en: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
verses.am: የሚያሳፍረኝንም ተግሣጽ ሰምቻለሁ፥  የማስተዋሌም መንፈስ ይመልስልኛል።

verses.en: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
verses.am: ሰው በምድር ላይ ከተቀመጠ፥ ከዱሮ ዘመን ጀምሮ፥

verses.en: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?
verses.am: የኃጢአተኛ ፉከራ አጭር መሆኑን  የዝንጉዎችም ደስታ ቅጽበት መሆኑን አታውቁምን?

verses.en: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;
verses.am: ከፍታው ወደ ሰማይ ቢወጣ፥  ራሱም እስከ ደመና ቢደርስ፥

verses.en: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?
verses.am: እንደ ፋንድያ ለዘላለም ይጠፋል፤  ያዩትም። ወዴት ነው? ይላሉ።

verses.en: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
verses.am: እንደ ሕልም ይበርራል፥ እርሱም አይገኝም፤  እንደ ሌሊትም ራእይ ይሰደዳል።

verses.en: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
verses.am: ያየችውም ዓይን ዳግመኛ አታየውም፤  ስፍራውም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይመለከተውም።

verses.en: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.
verses.am: ልጆቹ ድሆቹን ያቈላምጣሉ፤  እጁ ሀብቱን ይመልሳል።

verses.en: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
verses.am: አጥንቶቹ ብላቴንነቱን ሞልተዋል፤  ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ጋር በመሬት ውስጥ ይተኛል።

verses.en: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;
verses.am: ክፋት በአፉ ውስጥ ቢጣፍጥ፥  ከምላሱም በታች ቢሰውረው፥

verses.en: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:
verses.am: ቢጠብቀውም ባይተወውም፥  በጕሮሮውም ቢይዘው፥

verses.en: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.
verses.am: መብሉ በአንጀቱ ውስጥ ይገላበጣል፤  እንደ እፉኝትም ሐሞት በውስጡ ይሆናል።

verses.en: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: YAHUAH shall cast them out of his belly.
verses.am: የዋጠውን ሀብት ይተፋዋል፤  እግዚአብሔርም ከሆዱ ውስጥ ያወጣዋል።

verses.en: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's tongue shall slay him.
verses.am: የእፉኝትን መርዝ ይጠባል፤  የእባብም ምላስ ይገድለዋል።

verses.en: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
verses.am: የማሩንና የቅቤውን ፈሳሽ  ወንዞቹንም አይመለከትም።

verses.en: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.
verses.am: የድካሙን ፍሬ ሳይውጠው ይመልሰዋል፤  እንደ ንግዱም ትርፍ አይደሰትም።

verses.en: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;
verses.am: ድሀውን አስጨንቆአል፥ ትቶታልም፤  ያልሠራውንም ቤት በዝብዞአል።

verses.en: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
verses.am: ሆዱ ዕረፍትን አላወቀምና  የወደደው ነገር አላዳነውም።

verses.en: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.
verses.am: እርሱ ከበላ በኋላ ምንም አልተረፈም፤  ስለዚህ በረከቱ አይከናወንለትም።

verses.en: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
verses.am: በጠገበ ጊዜ ይጨነቃል፤  የችግረኞችም ሁሉ እጅ ታገኘዋለች።

verses.en: When he is about to fill his belly, YAHUAH shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.
verses.am: ሆዱን ሳያጠግብ  እግዚአብሔር የቍጣውን ትኵሳት ይሰድድበታል፥  ሲበላም ያዘንብበታል።

verses.en: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.
verses.am: ከብረት መሣርያም ይሸሻል፥  የናስም ቀስት ይወጋዋል።

verses.en: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.
verses.am: እርሱም ይመዝዘዋል፥ ከሥጋውም ይወጣል፤  ከሐሞቱም ብልጭ ብሎ ይሠርጻል፤  ፍርሃትም ይወድቅበታል።

verses.en: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
verses.am: ጨለማ ሁሉ ስለ ከበረው ዕቃ ተዘጋጅቶአል፤  በሰው አፍ እፍ የማትባል እሳት ትበላዋለች፤  በድንኳኑ ውስጥ የቀረው ይጨነቅባታል።

verses.en: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.
verses.am: ሰማይ ኃጢአቱን ይገልጥበታል፥  ምድርም ትነሣበታለች።

verses.en: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
verses.am: የቤቱም ባለጠግነት ይሄዳል፤  በቍጣው ቀን እንደ ፈሳሽ ውኃ ያልፋል።

verses.en: This is the portion of a wicked man from YAHUAH, and the heritage appointed unto him by YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የበደለኛ ሰው እድል ፈንታ፥  ከእግዚአብሔርም የተመደበ ርስቱ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: But Job answered and said,
verses.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
